capital_constraint: One continuous initial EUR200 remains mandatory downstream. This pre-account headroom screen neither creates a second balance nor adds primitive returns as feasible portfolio earnings. No HARD21 entries.
cost_policy: No October commission/margin/FX backdated to September. Unknown slippage/fees/funding/FX/actual execution remain unknown; no EUR cash/return. Nonnegative extra costs reduce conditional quoted gross, but absent liquidity/fill proof prevents a universal rejection or profitability claim.
decision: DATA_LIMITED if censor fraction>5% or any complete path unmarked; otherwise support, gross, five-day gates. A full pass is CONDITIONAL_GROSS_HEADROOM_COSTS_UNRESOLVED, never net edge. Every outcome ends the fixed identity; no tuning, automatic followup or independent confirmation. Unresolved episodes are not assumed zero or deleted.
entry: Strictly later first valid group>=decision+250ms and<=decision+1000ms. Any unavailable preentry group censors. No entry quote at the decision.
exit: First strictly-positive usable group>=entry+1000ms and<=entry+1500ms. Timeout or terminal pending/open episode is censored, never liquidated at a guessed price. Fixed3000ms decision holdoff applies equally to all complete/censored outcomes.
exposure: Intermediate locked books remain descriptive noncrossed marks, not fills/free costs. Missing/conflicting/crossed/stale intermediate groups remain unmarked and flag unresolved risk. No continuous valuation, stop or account claim. Old strict consumer and closed models unchanged.
hypothesis: An isolated bid drop or ask rise that at least doubles the previously observed positive spread predicts a very short reversal, potentially exceeding quoted bid/ask execution friction. Distinct from completed-bar fade/momentum, USD leader-follower and directional-change threshold models; no fitted coefficient.
primitive_units: 1000 base units is a normalization only, not funded or historically executable minimum. BUY entryASK/exitBID; SELL entryBID/exitASK; grossUSD=direction*(exit-entry)*1000. This is spread-only headroom BEFORE unresolved nonspread costs, not trading with zero fees.
privacy: Every economic number/decision/episode/censor is encrypted to existing recipient. Public only source counts, exact provenance, boolean gates, fixed verdict/budget. Preserve actual evaluator DLL and original encrypted result; separate same-job custody readback is not independent algorithm or market confirmation.
sampling: All original same-ms groups, no within-group side ordering. Existing immutable CSharp/Python atomic source cursor. Conflicting same-side revisions invalidate that side until renewed. No missing-group interpolation or favorable period selection.
selection_basis: Existing authenticated source availability and observed support, not directional return ranking; complete fixed week/all eligible times. GBPUSD was previously exposed in other dependent research; no fresh-independent evidence claim. Entire authorized Pepperstone universe remains open.
signal: Both adjacent groups strictly positive, sides no older than5000 source-ms, adjacent gap<=1000ms. If only BID is updated and bid drops by at least the prior spread, BUY; if only ASK is updated and ask rises by at least prior spread, SELL. Both-side updates cannot signal. Signals Monday-Friday UTC only; entry/exit remain observed source quotes, not actual receipts.
